short: A uniform bound on twisted second cohomology

lean.name: UpperTheory.V.LemmaK
lean.plain: A uniform bound on twisted second cohomology
lean.note: For the twists outside the cyclotomic-tower estimate, the paper uses a bound on the logarithm of the order of the degree-two cohomology group. Its inputs are the twist, the degree and the absolute discriminant of a totally complex field containing the required roots of unity, including a primitive fourth root when $\ell=2$.
